profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, trading on public markets under the ticker META. Its llama.com site presents the company as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which the site describes as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. Reported revenue for the period ending 2025-12-31, per a 10-K filing, was $200,966,000,000.

The company's AI product lineup, as described on its site, centers on several models and tools. Muse Spark is described as a coding-optimized model built for writing, reviewing, and shipping code with fewer steps and lower latency, with version 1.2 accompanied by Muse Code, a coding agent built to run it. Muse Glimmer is described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows, sized to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also highlights multi-agent workflow capabilities, search grounding for live web access, and the Llama open-weight model family, which is often self-hosted.

The held facts note three active legal cases involving Meta: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Several third-party MCP servers referencing Meta's advertising platforms, including tools for Facebook and Instagram ad automation, campaign management, and performance analysis, appear in the registry under Meta's profile.
